questions.stem: Following statements about SLE are true EXCEPT:

options.label: A
options.text: IV Methylprednisolone is preferred drug in emergency

options.label: B
options.text: Belimumab is an approved anti-CD20 antibody for SLE treatment

options.label: C
options.text: Vitamin D3 supplementation reduces disease activity.

options.label: D
options.text: Hydroxychloroquine is the cornerstone of SLE therapy
